title: trimmedmmd: code and data for "Certifying total-variation contamination by betting on trimmed kernel witnesses"
description: The Python package trimmedmmd and the scripts behind every table and figure of the paper "Certifying total-variation contamination by betting on trimmed kernel witnesses" (submitted to the Annals of Statistics). The Lean 4 formalization of the paper's numbered results is at https://github.com/HristoInouzhe/trimmed-mmd-lean.
